Popular YouTuber Dhruv Rathee, in his recent video in February 2026, has provided a detailed clarification regarding the latest documents released in the Jeffrey Epstein case. Addressing the viral claims on social media, Rathee emphasized that there is no evidence of any direct contact or link between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Epstein.

He explained that the references to PM Modi's 2017 Israel visit in the documents were part of a broader diplomatic discussion involving former Trump strategist Steve Bannon. Rathee clarified that the controversial phrases like "singing and dancing" used in the files were metaphorical terms referring to diplomatic maneuvering rather than literal actions. This clarification aligns with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) statement, which rejected the claims as "baseless ruminations" of a convicted criminal.
